tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// zab bdun gshin rje 'khor lo rol pa'i lha dbang gter gzhung zur bkol bzhugs//

de nas gtso bo gzhi lus rigs bzhi dang: phyogs skyong lhu tshigs sgo ba mthil bzhi la: bstims nas so so'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: phyag drug rdo rje ral gri dgra st+wa g.yas: sdigs mdzub mdung thung bhan dmar g.yon gyis 'dzin: khro gtum mi bzad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: rdo rje'i gshog pa gdengs shing zhabs bzhi bgrad: bai tā nag mo dgra st+wa dung dmar stob: ral gcig mthing nag rtse gsum thod khrag stob: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: dpal chen 'jam dpal yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka hūm̐: bhi dha li rakṣa mañdzu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: oṃ e kā dza ṭi trag raksha mu dra snying kha ragmo ru lu ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: ya ma rā dza mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal: 'khor lo tri shul lcags kyu g.yas na 'dzin: kha ṭwāṃ dgra st+wa rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: g.yu yi ral gcig g.yon 'khyud rgyu zhags 'dzin: re ti ral gri ne'u le'i rkyal pa thogs: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: ya ma rā dza yab yub dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma rā dza de wa tho la la ya ma hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rakmo rakmo snying rtsa la sham bhyo: te ma te bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: myos byed 'bar ba ser dkar nag po'i zhal: be con ral gri dgra st+wa g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar 'khor lo lcags kyu g.yon na bsnams: gtum mo dug hrul g.yon 'khyud dung dmar stob: khrag gi bdag mo spu gri tipta 'dzin: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: myos byed 'bar ba yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma rā dza pre gyi ta pi si marta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rakmo rakmo khrag la mu sham bhyo: ya ma de byi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: me ru tse ni dmar dkar sngo ba'i zhal:

be con ral gri kha ṭwāṃ g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar 'khor lo rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: 'od zer can ma utpal bhan dmar stob: gling bzhi gtsug 'joms mi snying bhandha thogs: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: ārya mer tse yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma rā dza pra ti dzwa la hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ragmo ragmo ta la ma ma bhyo: na sha de byi hūm̐ phaṭa: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: ral pa tshar dgu ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal: be con gtun shing rgya gram g.yas na 'dzin: bhan dmar 'khor lo rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams: re ti g.yon 'khril khram shing bhan dmar stob: srin mo mgo 'phyang dgra st+wa dung dmar stob: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: ral pa tshar dgu yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma rā tsa ka yakṣa sro srod ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rakmo rakmo ting ting kā la ma bhyo: kha raka de byi hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje nag 'joms sku mdog nag: rdo rje rtse lnga g.yas la dgra st+wa g.yon: srin mo ral gcig nag mo kha ṭwāṃ dang: bhandha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje nag 'joms yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra ya ma raksha kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma ma rakmo rakmo ru lu ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje phywa tshangs sku mdog dkar: g.yas pas tshe bum g.yon pas thong gshol bsnams: shel gyi gdong dgu ser po ral gri dang: bhandha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje phywa tshangs yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā hri ti hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rakmo rakmo raksha ru lu ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje kong rje brag 'joms sku mdog dkar: g.yas pas brag ri g.yon pas me phung bsnams: brag srin shel mig dkar po lcags kyu dang: bhandha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril:

thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: kong rje brag 'joms yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma ma hā san ti hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rakmo ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje a wa glang mgo smug nag 'bar: g.yas pas kha ṭwāṃ g.yon pas lcags kyu bsnams: bdud mo mche gtsigs smug nag me long dang: skar mda' 'phen cing yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: a wa glang mgo yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma hrīḥku ru hūm̐: oṃ ma ma hri ti snying ru bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje ya ba ti ni sngo nag zhal: g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas lcags kyu bsnams: dred kyi aṃ shaṃ nag mo khram shing dang: thod khrag 'thung zhing yab dang gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje ya ba ti yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma si ti hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma hā raksha ma he ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje mig dmar smug nag 'bar ba'i zhal: g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas zhing dbyug bsnams: khrag mig dmar mo gtun shing 'bar ba dang: tsitta 'dzin nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje mig dmar yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma a dya ta ra hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rakmo ta na ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje rmig pa dud kha'i mdog tu 'bar: g.yas pas thod phreng g.yon pas lcags sgrog bsnams: klu mo pus 'gro smug nag mda' gzhu dang: bhandha thogs nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje rmig pa yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā raksha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ nā ga ru lu bhyo: ā bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje tel pa sngo nag 'bar ba'i zhal: g.yas pas spu gri g.yon pas dbyug to bsnams: rlung lha spyan gsum nag mo spu gri dang:

bhandha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje tel pa yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma sarba pa ta hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ba sha ma bo ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje bdud 'joms sku mdog smug nag 'bar: g.yas pas dgra st+wa g.yon pas tho ba bsnams: chu srin nag mo smug nag ral gri dang: bhandha khrag bkang bsnams nas yab la 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje bdud 'joms yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma a baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ yakṣa yagmo ru lu ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje chos rgyal dkar la ser ba'i mdog: rdo rje rtse gsum g.yas la khram shing g.yon: nam gru ser mo las kyi me long dang: nyi zer thod khrag bsnams nas yab la 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje chos rgyal yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma dharma rā tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma ma e ke rakmo bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje 'bar ba dmar nag 'bar ba'i zhal: khram shing g.yas la rtsis kyi byang bu g.yon: nag mo mgo dgu dmar nag rtse gsum dang: bhandha khrag bkang bsnams nas yab la 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje 'bar ba yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma de wa dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ya ma rakmo ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: gshin rje thod dbyug sku mdog nag po'i zhal: ro yi dbyug pa rtsis kyi rdil bu bsnams: sa bdag nag mo phag mgo rdo rje'i zhags: bhandha bsnams nas yab la gnyis med 'khril: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: gshin rje thod dbyug yab yum dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma tri ti baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ kā la rakmo ru lu bhyo: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: sgo ba dung gi bya rgod mgo can dkar: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin:

thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: dung gi bya rgod mgo can dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma aṃ ku sha dza: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: sgo ba gser gyi stag mgo ser nag 'bar: g.yas pas rin chen g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: sgo ba gser gyi stag mgo'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma pā sha hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: sgo ba bswe yi kaṅka'i mgo can dmar: g.yas pas padma g.yon pas lcags sgrog 'dzin: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bswe yi kaṅka'i mgo can dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma spho ṭa baṃ: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: sgo ba lcags kyi spyang mgo ljang nag 'bar: g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i byin rlabs kyis: sgo ba lcags kyi spyang mo'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ya ma gaṇḍe ho: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: nam mkha' mdzod nas kho bo mchog gyur gling pas spyan drangs pa'o/// /
